catalog.provenance: extracted verbatim from Shawn's approved designs
catalog.specimens: each block's specimen.html in its block directory

laws.name: Black root
laws.rule: Page ground deep black (#050507 family); no path for white to leak in; <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark"> required

laws.name: Text is white
laws.rule: Text white 99% of the time; hierarchy by size — 24px headline / 18px body / 14px detail — never gray or colored text

laws.name: No freestyle components
laws.rule: Every component class must exist in the block manifest; if no block fits, file the gap, never invent silently

laws.name: Buttons: black heart, white voice
laws.rule: Black base, purple edge glow at rest, light up white on interaction; never colored text on buttons

laws.name: Purple is accent and glow
laws.rule: Purple is accent/glow (soul/chrome), never a solid fill or background

laws.name: One spectrum accent per item
laws.rule: Magenta → purple → blue → green → gold; never cross the color jobs (chrome / text / theme)

laws.name: Self-contained delivery
laws.rule: One file, all CSS/JS inlined, no external refs; verify from an empty folder the way he will open it

laws.name: No manufactured numbers
laws.rule: Every number carries provenance or it doesn't ship

laws.name: Verify through his eyes
laws.rule: Screenshot the artifact the way he'll experience it; his screen is the test environment

laws.name: The Usefulness Gate
laws.rule: If it's not useful it can never be used; silence beats garbage

prerequisite: Complete after the general activation (activation-checklist.json), before writing a single line of CSS
purpose: The design-specific entry sequence a Naya completes before touching any design work: load the 10 design laws, load the block catalog, study the specimens, compose from blocks, pass the pre-delivery check.
rule_zero: You do not design from scratch. You take the pieces and put them together beautifully.
sections: Step 3 — Look at what elite looks like
steps: Step 1 — Load the 10 load-bearing laws (from DESIGN-LAWS.md; name each back; do not work from memory)
Step 2 — Load the block catalog; name candidate blocks before writing code
Step 3 — Look at what elite looks like (specimens + gallery)
Step 4 — Compose, don't create (blocks first: layout → components → content; custom CSS only for glue)
Step 5 — Pre-delivery check (traceability, Laws 4/5/6, provenance, his-eyes verification, Usefulness Gate)
title: DESIGN ACTIVATION — before touching any design work
